title: WPMS/1286/2002 of LAXMI DEVI Vs D.J. NAINITAL and ORS

paras.text:
RESERVED
Civil Petition no. 1286 (M/S) of 2002
Laxman Devi ------------------------ Petitioner
Versus
District Judge Nainital and another------------------------- Respondents
Hon'ble M.M.Ghildiyal J.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
The plaintiff-respondent no.2 instituted a small cause court suit no.7
of 1996 for eviction of the petitioner tenant. The said suit was decreed. The
petitioner after more than 1/1/2 year filed a revision alongwith application
under section 5 of the Limitation Act. The said application for condonation
of delay was rejected after hearing the parties on 23.3.2002 by the District
Judge, Nainital. Thereafter the petitioner moved review petition, which was
also rejected by the District Judge vide his judgment dated 19.10.2002. I find
no infirmity in the order.
However learned counsel for the petitioner has confined his
submission to the extent that the petitioner may be permitted to vacate the
premises in question within nine months and he is ready to give undertaking
to this effect. the petitioner is permitted to vacate the premises immediately
after expiry of nine months provided he gives an undertaking before the
court below to the effect that he will vacate the premises immediately after
expiry of nine months. The petitioner shall give this undertaking within a
period of two months from today.
With these observations the writ petition is disposed of finally. No
order as to the costs.
(M.M.Ghildiyal, J.)
February 17, 2003
MPS
